messages:
Maria (FinOps): Heads-up — I pulled the ScaleLedger trial invoice and there's a weird line 'vector.unit 4,200 @ $0.0005' that doesn't match our CSV export. Anyone seen this format before?
ScaleLedger Rep: Hi Maria — sorry about the confusion. We rolled out new metering last quarter. 'vector.unit' is billed per embedding vector (1 unit = 1 vector). Generative calls are billed as 'token.unit' per 1k tokens. We should have surfaced the change.
Sam (Platform Eng): Quick question: if we send a batch of 10 inputs in one embedding request, does that count as 10 vector.units or 1?
ScaleLedger Rep: It counts as 10 vector.units. Batching doesn't aggregate units — units == number of output embeddings.
Leo (SaaS Ops): Can you share a concise mapping table so we can model cost impact for chat + batch embed jobs?
ScaleLedger Rep: Sure — docs here: https://scaleledger.example/pricing-metering. Short sample invoice lines below:
```
line_item,qty,unit,unit_price,amount
vector.unit,4200,vector,$0.0005,$2.10
token.unit,150000,1k-token,$0.50,$75.00
```
Maria (FinOps): That sample doesn't match the CSV export we download from the billing console. Our CSV has fields 'emb_count' and 'emb_bytes' — the numbers don't reconcile.
ScaleLedger Rep: We maintain two exports: the legacy CSV (emb_count/emb_bytes) and the newer normalized invoice (vector.unit). We'll produce a reconciliation script/mapping file that converts legacy fields to vector.unit counts.
Ivy (Legal): Also — trial contract language referenced 'net 30 post acceptance' but renewal appears to have auto-triggered. What is the termination notice window?
ScaleLedger Rep: Auto-renew is 30 days prior notice. If renewal invoiced prematurely we'll pause collection while we reconcile. We'll also provide contract amendment language to clarify notice and billing formats.
Maria (FinOps): Requesting a provisional credit while you reconcile — our rough estimate shows ~ $7.2k discrepancy if counts were doubled during trial. Can you provision that?
ScaleLedger Rep: We can issue a provisional credit of $7,200 and reissue a corrected invoice within 5 business days. Additionally we can extend a 10% committed-tier discount if you sign a 12-month reservation.
Sam (Platform Eng): If we take the commit, can you guarantee per-output counting semantics for our batched upload path? We need that in writing to avoid surprises.
ScaleLedger Rep: Yes. We'll add explicit SKU mapping and contract language: "units counted per output vector" and provide an audit log for usage for the first 90 days.
Maria (FinOps): OK — please put the credit and corrected invoice in writing and loop in Legal. @Ivy we need signoff to accept the 10% commit trade.
Ivy (Legal): I'll review the amendment and approve provisional credit + pause on payment until corrected invoice arrives.
Leo (SaaS Ops): Sam and I will run a usage model and report expected monthly delta by EOD.
Maria (FinOps): Action items: Sam -> usage delta model; ScaleLedger Rep -> provisional credit + corrected invoice + reconciliation script; Ivy -> contract review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ProcureBot: Reminder — vendor requires PO# before applying any credit. Please attach PO to the ticket.
Maria (FinOps): On it. I'll generate PO-2026-045 and send to ScaleLedger.
